title: ModelInfo
description: Metadata for a single AI model as produced by the bestiary CLI JSON formatter.

Provider.description: Organization that hosts or publishes the model (e.g. "anthropic").

RawFamily.description: Raw API family field verbatim as returned by the upstream API (e.g. "claude-opus", "gemini-flash").

Family.description: Canonical family identifier extracted from RawFamily (or inferred from ID when RawFamily is empty). Populated at codegen time.

Variant.description: Variant suffix extracted from RawFamily (e.g. "opus-4", "pro", "flash"). Empty when the model has no variant. Populated at codegen time.

Version.description: Model version extracted from the family string (e.g. "4.5" for claude-opus-4-5, "2.5" for gemini-2.5-flash). Empty when the model has no separable version. Populated at codegen time.

Date.description: Release date extracted from the model ID or ReleaseDate field in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty when no date is found. Populated at codegen time.

Modifier.description: List of known trailing tokens extracted from the model ID that carry semantic meaning beyond family/variant/version/date (e.g. ["thinking"], ["vision","instruct"]). Stored in deterministic canonical order (capability > speed > format/stage, alpha fallback). null when no known modifier is found. Widened from string to array of strings for lossless multi-modifier capture. Release-stage tokens (preview/latest/original) remain in this list as data but are excluded from entity keys and canonical rendering — the Stage property carries that axis (see the ReleaseStage $def).

ContextWindow.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can process in a single request.

MaxOutput.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response.

Reasoning.description: Whether the model supports chain-of-thought or extended reasoning.

ToolCall.description: Whether the model supports tool/function calling.

Attachment.description: Whether the model supports file attachments.

Temperature.description: Whether the model exposes a temperature parameter.

StructuredOutput.description: Whether the model supports structured JSON output.

Interleaved.description: Polymorphic capability for interleaved reasoning. Supported indicates whether the capability is active; Config holds optional configuration (e.g. {"field": "reasoning_details"}).

Supported.description: Whether the interleaved capability is enabled.

Config.description: Optional capability configuration key-value pairs, or null if not applicable.

OpenWeights.description: Whether the model weights are publicly available.

CostInputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens, or null if unknown.

CostOutputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens, or null if unknown.

CostReasoningPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million reasoning tokens, or null if unknown.

CostCacheReadPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache-read tokens, or null if unknown.

CostCacheWritePerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache-write tokens, or null if unknown.

ReleaseDate.description: Model release date string as provided by the upstream API (e.g. "2024-01-01").

Knowledge.description: Knowledge cutoff date string as provided by the upstream API.

Modalities.description: Input and output modalities supported by the model.

LastSynced.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when this model record was last fetched from the upstream API.

Host.description: Serving host / backend infrastructure that runs this model instance, distinct from Provider (e.g. "azure", "aws"). A per-instance attribute that never participates in entity identity. Empty string when unknown or when the provider serves the model directly. Added in schema 0.1.0; optional for backward compatibility with 0.0.x records.

Lineage.description: Derivation edges from this model to its parent model(s) (finetune, merge, distillation, etc.). null when the model is a base model or no curated lineage is known. Added in schema 0.1.0; optional for backward compatibility with 0.0.x records.

ParamSize.description: Canonical parameter-size token for this model instance (e.g. "70b", "8b", "0.5b"). Empty string when the size is unknown or not applicable. Participates in entity identity via the #size segment of EntityRef.String(). Optional; absent for models without curated size data.

TotalParams.description: Total parameter count decomposed from ParamSize (e.g. 30000000000 for "30b"; exact for decimal tokens, e.g. 10700000000 for "10.7b"). In-domain NULL sentinel contract: -1 means NULL (not populated by parser or curation) — set when the shape carries no total (an NxM token "8x22b" records ExpertCount and PerExpertParams; a count-suffixed token "17b-16e" records ActiveParams and ExpertCount; the product is never computed) OR when the size is unknown (all four are -1). A positive value is an attested count; 0 never appears on this field. Derived presentation fact, never entity-key material. Optional (additive).

ActiveParams.description: Active (per-forward-pass) parameter count of a mixture-of-experts model (e.g. 3000000000 for "30b-a3b"; 17000000000 for "17b-16e"). In-domain NULL sentinel contract: -1 means NULL (not populated) — set for a dense model or when the size is unknown. A positive value is an attested count; 0 never appears on this field. Derived presentation fact, never entity-key material. Optional (additive).

PerExpertParams.description: Per-expert parameter count of an NxM MoE token (e.g. 22000000000 for "8x22b"). In-domain NULL sentinel contract: -1 means NULL (not populated) — set unless the shape is NxM (only "NxMb" tokens populate it) or when the size is unknown. A positive value is an attested count; 0 never appears on this field. Derived presentation fact, never entity-key material. Optional (additive).

ExpertCount.description: Number of experts of a mixture-of-experts model (8 for "8x22b", 16 for "17b-16e", 128 for "17b-128e"). In-domain NULL sentinel contract: -1 means NULL (not populated) — set for a MoE shape that carries no expert count (active-MoE "30b-a3b") or when the size is unknown. A genuine 0 is reachable ONLY on this field: a dense shape attests exactly zero experts. A positive value is an attested count. Derived presentation fact, never entity-key material. Optional (additive).

QuantVRAM.description: Per-quantization weight and VRAM footprint rows for this model instance. null when no quantization data is available. Populated at codegen time from curated data; live-sync rows carry null.

Source.description: Originating ingest source that attests this model row (e.g. "models.dev", "ollama"). Defaults to "models.dev": every row originates from the models.dev pipeline, so an unset carrier is filled in to "models.dev" at the load layer; a row enriched by a further source carries that source instead. Added in schema 0.2.0.

Description.description: Upstream model description from the api.json side of the models.dev catalog. Empty string when none is provided. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility with 0.2.x records.

Status.description: Upstream release status for this model instance ("none" means generally available / stable). An instance-level fact from the api.json side. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

StatusRaw.description: Verbatim upstream status token, populated only when Status is "other" (an unrecognized token); empty otherwise. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Stage.description: Release stage DERIVED from the model ID (preview/beta/latest/original), distinct in provenance from Status: Status is upstream-declared lifecycle from the api.json side, while Stage is read out of the ID token stream. "none" (the zero value) when the ID carries no recognized stage marker. A per-instance attribute; never entity-key material. Added in schema 0.4.0; optional for backward compatibility.

StageRaw.description: Verbatim stage token, populated only when Stage is "other" (the reserved bucket for a future non-ID stage feeder); empty for every ID-derived stage this epoch. Mirrors StatusRaw. Added in schema 0.4.0; optional for backward compatibility.

ReasoningOptions.description: Reasoning-control options this model exposes (toggle / effort / budget-tokens). null when the model exposes none. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

CostInputAudioPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million audio-input tokens, or null if unknown. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

CostOutputAudioPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million audio-output tokens, or null if unknown. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

CostContextOver200k.description: Fixed context-over-200k-tokens pricing override, or null when the model declares none. Upstream's legacy fixed-threshold special case, kept distinct from CostTiers for wire fidelity. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

CostTiers.description: General context-size-conditional price tiers. null when the model declares none. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Region.description: Serving jurisdiction of this instance: the AWS Bedrock cross-region inference-profile region encoded in the model-ID prefix (us./eu./au./jp./global.). A per-instance attribute that never participates in entity identity. "unspecified" (the zero value) when the ID carries no region prefix. Added in schema 0.5.0; optional for backward compatibility.

RegionRaw.description: Verbatim region token, populated only when Region is "other" (a recognized-but-unmapped region token); empty for every named member and for "unspecified". Mirrors StatusRaw/StageRaw. Added in schema 0.5.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Creator.description: The lab / organization that TRAINED this model (the SPDX "originator"), DISTINCT from Provider (the SPDX "supplier"/distributor). A DERIVED join projection of Family → Creator baked at codegen from the curated creators.json seed, never a stored column. Empty string (CreatorNone) when the family has no curated mapping. Added in schema 0.6.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Creator.title: Creator
Creator.description: The lab / organization that TRAINED a model (the SPDX "originator"), DISTINCT from Provider (the SPDX "supplier"/distributor): one lab's models are hosted by many providers, and one provider hosts many labs' models. An OPEN lowercase-token string type mirroring Provider (the set of labs grows as the huggingface ingest surfaces new originators). "" (CreatorNone) is the honest zero value for a family with no curated mapping — bestiary emits nothing rather than a wrong-but-plausible guess. The initial well-known set is the nine UAT-confirmed labs; the mapping is Family → Creator, resolved via the curated creators.json seed. Added in schema 0.6.0.

AttestationAuthority.title: AttestationAuthority
AttestationAuthority.description: Whose VOICE an attestation's evidence document is — a per-attestation fact (the links[] relay scenario ruled out per-DataSource placement). Serializes as a lowercase token via encoding.TextMarshaler. Element-enum convention: every attestation arrives with a value, so "unknown" sits AT the zero value as the fail-safe. Added in schema 0.6.0.

x-enum-descriptions.unknown: Fail-safe (the zero value): the authority is not yet recognized.
x-enum-descriptions.primary: The namespace owner / creator speaking for itself (e.g. the Hub for a huggingface naming, the lab for its canonical scheme).
x-enum-descriptions.secondary: An aggregator / relayer reporting the naming (e.g. a catalog spelling a provider ID).

IngestMethod.title: IngestMethod
IngestMethod.description: HOW a naming record entered the system — a per-attestation fact, symmetric with AttestationAuthority (a single source such as models.dev is simultaneously the source of self-minted canonical nomina AND of harvested provider-id nomina, so this cannot live on the DataSource dimension). Serializes as a lowercase token via encoding.TextMarshaler. Element-enum convention: "unknown" sits AT the zero value as the fail-safe. Added in schema 0.6.0.

x-enum-descriptions.unknown: Fail-safe (the zero value): the ingest method is not recognized.
x-enum-descriptions.curated: From a committed curated seed (e.g. nomen_claims.json).
x-enum-descriptions.harvested: Bot-fetched from an external registry (models.dev / HuggingFace / Ollama).
x-enum-descriptions.self-minted: bestiary-authored (a canonical key or a purl derivation).

NomenAttestation.title: NomenAttestation
NomenAttestation.description: One independent piece of evidence for a Nomen (the Wikidata per-claim-reference model): each attestation stands on its own, and two sources asserting the same name append two attestations rather than overwriting. A Nomen HAS-MANY attestations (>=1). The two provenance levels SourceURL (WHO asserts) and Source (WHICH ingest we read it from) must never be conflated (the BenchmarkResult discipline). ArchivedURL is a third, distinct thing: not a provenance level but a durability aid for SourceURL. Added in schema 0.6.0; ArchivedURL added in 0.7.0.

SourceURL.description: WHO asserts this naming (the claimant URL); empty for a self-minted attestation.

ArchivedURL.description: An archive.org snapshot OF SourceURL (https://web.archive.org/web/<14-digit-timestamp>/<original-url>); a best-effort durability aid for the HARVESTED layer, whose SourceURL is a live page. Empty when no snapshot is recorded, and empty on a curated claim (whose SourceURL already IS the snapshot). Additive: SourceURL stays primary and unchanged. Added in schema 0.7.0.

Source.description: WHICH ingest we read this attestation from (a DataSourceID; e.g. "models.dev").

Authority.description: Whose voice the evidence document is (per-attestation).

Method.description: How this record entered the system (per-attestation).

IngestedAt.description: Committed snapshot RFC3339 timestamp; empty (honest) when unknown.

ModelRef.title: ModelRef
ModelRef.description: The canonical identity of a model. The identity tuple (ID, Provider, RawFamily, Family, Variant, Version, ParamSize, Date) is the stable anchor for cross-provider queries, canonical formatting, and the normalization pipeline. ParamSize is part of identity, mirroring EntityRef.ParamSize: instances of one family at different sizes are distinct.

ID.description: Original API model identifier (e.g. "claude-opus-4-20250514"). Corresponds to the ModelID type in Go.

Provider.description: Organization that hosts or publishes the model (e.g. "anthropic").

RawFamily.description: API family field verbatim as returned by the upstream API (e.g. "claude-opus").

Family.description: Canonical family identifier after normalization (e.g. "claude"). Empty if not yet normalized.

Variant.description: Canonical variant suffix (e.g. "opus", "sonnet", "haiku"). Empty when the model has no variant.

Version.description: Model version extracted from the family string (e.g. "4.5" for claude-opus-4-5, "2.5" for gemini-2.5-flash). Empty when the model has no separable version.

ParamSize.description: Canonical parameter-size token (e.g. "70b", "8b", "0.5b"). Part of the canonical identity tuple, mirroring EntityRef.ParamSize: instances of one family at different sizes are distinct identities. Empty when size is unknown. Added in schema 0.3.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Date.description: Release date in YYYY-MM-DD format extracted from the model ID. Empty if none was found.

Modifier.description: List of known trailing tokens extracted from the model ID that carry semantic meaning (e.g. ["thinking"], ["vision","instruct"]), in canonical order. null when none. Widened from string to array of strings to match ModelRef.Modifier []string.

Host.description: Serving host / backend that runs this instance (e.g. "azure"), distinct from Provider. Per-instance attribute, never part of identity. Empty string when unknown. Added in schema 0.1.0; optional for backward compatibility.

EntityRef.title: EntityRef
EntityRef.description: Canonical identity of a model entity: the tuple (Family, Variant, Version, ParamSize) plus identity-class modifiers. Version is the identity version, NOT a release date (EntityRef has no Date field). ParamSize is the canonical parameter-size token and is part of identity. Modifier holds only identity-class modifiers, in canonical order. Its String() form family[/variant][@version][#paramsize]{identity-mods} is the comparable entity key; per-instance attributes never appear in it.

Variant.description: Canonical variant suffix. Empty when the entity has no variant.

Version.description: Identity version (e.g. "4.5", "3.1"). Empty when the entity has no separable version. This is NOT a release date.

ParamSize.description: Canonical parameter-size token (e.g. "70b", "8b", "0.5b"). Part of entity identity via the #size segment of EntityRef.String(): "llama@3.3#70b{instruct}" and "llama@3.3#8b{instruct}" are distinct entities. Empty when size is unknown — the #segment is then omitted so existing keys stay byte-identical. Added in schema 0.2.0; optional for backward compatibility.

Modifier.description: Identity-class modifiers only, in canonical order. null when none.

DerivationKind.title: DerivationKind
DerivationKind.description: How a model was derived from its parent(s): the edge label on a lineage relationship. Serializes as a lowercase text string via encoding.TextMarshaler.

x-enum-descriptions.finetune: Parameters further trained on additional data.
x-enum-descriptions.merge: Weights combined from two or more parent models (>= 2 parents).
x-enum-descriptions.distillation: A smaller student model trained to mimic a larger teacher.
x-enum-descriptions.quantized: A lower-precision copy of a parent model.
x-enum-descriptions.adapter: A parameter-efficient adapter (e.g. LoRA) over a base model.

LineageEdge.title: LineageEdge
LineageEdge.description: One directed derivation relationship: this model was derived from Parent via technique Kind. A model with multiple parents (e.g. a merge) carries multiple LineageEdges.

Parent.description: The parent entity this model was derived from.

Kind.description: The derivation technique relating this model to Parent.

CanonicalScheme.title: CanonicalScheme
CanonicalScheme.description: Identifies the string serialization format for a ModelRef. Controls how model identity is expressed as a string (e.g. for CLI output, SBOM generation, or HuggingFace Hub lookups).

x-enum-descriptions.canonical: Slash-separated canonical form: <provider>/<family>/<variant>@<date>. Variant and date segments are omitted when empty. Falls back to <provider>/<raw-id> when Family is empty.
x-enum-descriptions.huggingface: HuggingFace Hub form: <provider>/<raw-id>. Matches the repo-id used by the HuggingFace Hub API.
x-enum-descriptions.raw: Original API model ID verbatim (ModelRef.ID as a string).
x-enum-descriptions.oci: OCI package-URL scheme token (appended to the iota tail for wire stability). A per-quant-digest identity: ModelRef.Format(oci) returns "" BY DESIGN because a bare ref carries no single OCI identity — the digest lives at the quant/instance altitude. Added in schema 0.6.0.

AcceptabilityRating.title: AcceptabilityRating
AcceptabilityRating.description: Classifies a Designation by its acceptability status, following ISO 1087 terminology principles. All designations generated in the normalization epoch default to 'admitted'. Promotion to 'preferred' and assignment of 'deprecated' are deferred to a follow-up curation epoch.

x-enum-descriptions.admitted: Default rating. The designation is recognized and may be used, but is not the preferred form.
x-enum-descriptions.preferred: The designation is the recommended form. No designations are promoted to Preferred in the current epoch.
x-enum-descriptions.deprecated: The designation is no longer recommended. No designations are deprecated in the current epoch.

Designation.title: Designation
Designation.description: Pairs a model identity string with its serialization scheme, hosting provider, and acceptability rating. A single ModelRef may have multiple Designations: a canonical form, a raw API ID form, and optionally provider-specific alias forms.

Value.description: The serialized model identifier under the given Scheme.

Scheme.description: The serialization scheme used to produce Value.

Provider.description: The hosting provider associated with this designation. For cross-scheme designations (e.g. raw) the Provider is the original model's hosting provider.

Rating.description: Classifies acceptability. All epoch-generated designations are 'admitted'; promotion is deferred.

QuantVRAM.title: QuantVRAM
QuantVRAM.description: Per-quantization weight and VRAM footprint for one quantization variant of a model. WeightsBytes is the ground-truth ingested GGUF file size. VRAMBytes = WeightsBytes + KV-cache at VRAMContextTokens (model max context). VRAMEstimatePartial is true when the KV term was excluded because arch-facts (Layers/KVHeads/HeadDim) were absent.

Quant.description: Parsed quantization type. Serializes as a lowercase string via encoding.TextMarshaler.

QuantRaw.description: Verbatim quantization token from the source data, always populated for every row. Preserves the original casing exactly as it appeared in the source (e.g. "Q4_K_M" from an Ollama file_type field). Never empty when a row is present.

WeightsBytes.description: Ingested GGUF file size in bytes — the ground-truth weights footprint. 0 when unknown.

VRAMBytes.description: Estimated total VRAM in bytes: WeightsBytes + KV-cache at VRAMContextTokens. Equals WeightsBytes when VRAMEstimatePartial is true. 0 when unknown.

VRAMContextTokens.description: Context window in tokens used to compute VRAMBytes (the model-max context). 0 when unknown.

Layers.description: Number of transformer layers. 0 when unknown.

KVHeads.description: Number of KV-attention heads (GQA-aware). 0 when unknown.

HeadDim.description: Embedding width per attention head (elements per head). 0 when unknown.

VRAMEstimatePartial.description: True when the KV-cache term was excluded from VRAMBytes because at least one of Layers, KVHeads, or HeadDim is zero. Callers must check this flag before treating VRAMBytes as a full estimate.

OCIDigest.description: The "sha256:<hex>" content-addressed OCI manifest digest of this quantization's Ollama-registry artifact — the value that makes a pkg:oci purl (via QuantVRAM.OCIPurl) uniquely identify the artifact. Empty when absent; a FETCH-OWNED field captured by the offline cmd/bestiary-ollama refresh (empty for every curated row until a refresh harvests it). Added in schema 0.6.0; optional (omitted from required) for backward compatibility.

Quantization.title: Quantization
Quantization.description: The quantization scheme applied to a model's weights, identified by its canonical lowercase wire name. Serializes as a string via encoding.TextMarshaler (case-insensitive on unmarshal). "none" is the unquantized zero value; "other" is the fail-safe bucket for a recognized-but-unmapped tag. The GGUF/llama.cpp families (q*/iq*/f16/bf16/f32) carry an authoritative bits-per-weight; the reserved HF-ecosystem members (awq/gptq/int8/int4) are config-dependent and reserved for a later ingest.

x-enum-descriptions.none: Unquantized zero value: no quantization format specified.
x-enum-descriptions.q4_0: Legacy GGUF 4-bit block quant, scheme 0; ~4.5 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q4_1: Legacy GGUF 4-bit block quant, scheme 1; ~5.0 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q5_0: Legacy GGUF 5-bit block quant, scheme 0; ~5.5 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q5_1: Legacy GGUF 5-bit block quant, scheme 1; ~6.0 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.q8_0: Legacy GGUF 8-bit block quant, scheme 0; 8.5 bpw (llama.cpp).
x-enum-descriptions.awq: Reserved HF-ecosystem: Activation-aware Weight Quantization (4-bit); bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.gptq: Reserved HF-ecosystem: GPTQ post-training quantization (3/4/8-bit); bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.int8: Reserved HF-ecosystem: bitsandbytes 8-bit integer; bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.int4: Reserved HF-ecosystem: bitsandbytes 4-bit integer; bpw config-dependent.
x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket for a recognized-but-unmapped quantization tag; raw token carried on the instance.

ProviderInstance.title: ProviderInstance
ProviderInstance.description: A single concrete offering of an entity: one (provider, host) serving of a model, with its instance-specific pricing, limits, and ingest provenance. Many ProviderInstances roll up into one Entity. The fields here are the per-instance ATTRIBUTES — they vary across instances of the same entity and so are excluded from EntityRef.

ID.description: Original API model identifier for this instance.

Provider.description: Organization that hosts or publishes this instance (e.g. "anthropic").

Host.description: Serving host / backend that runs this instance (e.g. "azure"), distinct from Provider. Empty string when unknown or served directly.

Region.description: Serving jurisdiction of this instance (AWS Bedrock cross-region inference profile), projected from ModelInfo.Region. A per-instance attribute, never part of identity. "unspecified" when the ID carries no region prefix. Added in schema 0.5.0.

RegionRaw.description: Verbatim region token, populated only when Region is "other". Added in schema 0.5.0.

CostInputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens, or null if unknown.

CostOutputPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens, or null if unknown.

ContextWindow.description: Maximum number of tokens this instance can process in a single request.

MaxOutput.description: Maximum number of tokens this instance can generate in a single response.

QuantVRAM.description: Per-quantization weight and VRAM footprint rows for this instance. null when no quantization data is available for this row. Added in schema 0.2.0.

Source.description: Originating ingest source that attests this instance (e.g. "models.dev", "ollama"). Defaults to "models.dev": every instance originates from the models.dev pipeline, so an unset carrier is filled in to "models.dev" at the load layer; an instance enriched by a further source (e.g. an ollama-curated quantization row) carries that source instead. Added in schema 0.2.0.

CapabilityUnion.title: CapabilityUnion
CapabilityUnion.description: Aggregate capability view across all instances of an entity: each boolean is the OR over the corresponding per-instance capability (an entity supports a capability if ANY instance does). The zero value (all-false) is the identity-safe default for an entity with no instances.

Reasoning.description: Any instance supports chain-of-thought / extended reasoning.

ToolCall.description: Any instance supports tool / function calling.

Temperature.description: Any instance exposes a temperature parameter.

StructuredOutput.description: Any instance supports structured JSON output.

OpenWeights.description: Any instance has publicly available weights.

Entity.title: Entity
Entity.description: A model identity (Ref) together with every provider/host instance that serves it and the aggregate views derived from those instances. The unit returned by Entities() / EntityByTuple(). Range fields summarize the instances: PriceInputRange / PriceOutputRange are [min,max] over the NON-nil instance costs ({null,null} when every cost is nil); ContextRange / MaxOutputRange are [min,max] over instance context / max-output.

Ref.description: The canonical identity of this entity.

Instances.description: Every provider/host instance that serves this identity. null when the entity has no instances.

Lineage.description: Derivation edges from this entity to its parent(s). null when the entity is a base model or no curated lineage is known.

Providers.description: Distinct providers serving this entity. null when none.

Hosts.description: Distinct serving hosts for this entity. null when none.

Regions.description: Distinct serving jurisdictions (AWS Bedrock regions) for this entity, sorted ascending by Region enum value and de-duplicated. null when the entity went through no registry aggregate; a registry entity with no region prefix on any instance carries ["unspecified"]. Added in schema 0.5.0.

Nomina.description: Recorded namings of this entity (read-only projection surfaced in show --by-entity JSON output): the canonical key (Preferred), each distinct provider-ID spelling (Admitted), and any curated third-party alias claim resolving to this entity. Added in schema 0.5.0; optional (a derived projection, absent from the plain Entity struct marshaling).

PriceInputRange.description: [min,max] input cost in USD per million tokens over the NON-nil instance costs. Each bound is null when no instance has a known input cost.

PriceOutputRange.description: [min,max] output cost in USD per million tokens over the NON-nil instance costs. Each bound is null when no instance has a known output cost.

ContextRange.description: [min,max] context window in tokens over the instances.

MaxOutputRange.description: [min,max] max-output in tokens over the instances.

Capabilities.description: Aggregate (OR-over-instances) capability view for this entity.

Sources.description: Derived, sorted set of data sources attesting this entity's instances. Always contains at least "models.dev" for catalog entities. A read projection over the EntitySource join table, not a source of truth. Added in schema 0.2.0.

Metadata.description: Provider-agnostic model facts (description, license, links, benchmark claims) joined to this entity from the models.dev models.json side, or null when none was joined. A pointer field: genuinely optional. Added in schema 0.3.0.

Creator.description: The lab / organization that TRAINED this entity's models (the SPDX "originator"), DISTINCT from the Providers that host it. A DERIVED join projection of Ref.Family → Creator via the curated creators.json seed (the Sources/Regions projection precedent), not a stored column; one value covers the whole entity (all instances share Family). Empty string (CreatorNone) when the family has no curated mapping. Added in schema 0.6.0; optional for backward compatibility.

DataSource.title: DataSource
DataSource.description: A BCNF dimension row identifying a data source that provides model records to the registry (e.g. the models.dev API or the Ollama registry). URI is a second candidate key (UNIQUE) and is the single home for the source's location — it is NOT duplicated onto DatasetIngested.

ID.description: Stable source identifier (e.g. "models.dev", "ollama"). The primary key.

URI.description: Canonical location of the source (e.g. its API or registry URL). A second candidate key — UNIQUE across data sources.

CanonicalName.description: Human-readable display name for the source.

DatasetIngested.title: DatasetIngested
DatasetIngested.description: BCNF fact row recording the single current ingest of a data source (PK = SourceID, replace-on-refresh). It carries NO uri property: the URI is a transitive dependency on SourceID and lives only on DataSource, obtained by FK join. IngestedAt is a committed snapshot from the curated data, never a codegen wall-clock stamp (determinism).

SourceID.description: The DataSource this ingest belongs to (FK to DataSource.ID). The primary key — one current ingest per source.

IngestedAt.description: Timestamp of the ingest, a committed snapshot from the curated data (not a codegen wall-clock stamp).

ParserSchema.description: Parser/schema version under which the ingest was parsed.

EntitySource.title: EntitySource
EntitySource.description: A BCNF join-table row attesting that an entity is provided by a data source (composite PK = (EntityKey, SourceID)). The many-to-many relation between entities and data sources; Entity.Sources is its denormalized sorted read projection.

EntityKey.description: The entity key (EntityRef.String()) attested by SourceID. FK to a real entity.

SourceID.description: The data source attesting EntityKey (FK to DataSource.ID).

ModelStatus.title: ModelStatus
ModelStatus.description: Upstream release status an instance declares (from the api.json status field), identified by its canonical lowercase wire name. Serializes as a string via encoding.TextMarshaler. "none" is the zero value and means generally available / stable (absence is meaningful on this scalar field); "other" is the fail-safe bucket for an unrecognized token, whose raw value is carried on ModelInfo.StatusRaw. Added in schema 0.3.0.

x-enum-descriptions.none: No status declared: generally available / stable (the zero value).
x-enum-descriptions.beta: A later preview, more stable than alpha but not yet GA.
x-enum-descriptions.deprecated: Scheduled for or already past end-of-life.
x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket for a status token present upstream but unrecognized; raw token carried on ModelInfo.StatusRaw.

ReleaseStage.title: ReleaseStage
ReleaseStage.description: Release stage DERIVED from a model ID (an instance fact read out of the ID token stream by DetectStageFromID), identified by its canonical lowercase wire name. Serializes as a string via encoding.TextMarshaler. Deliberately SEPARATE from ModelStatus even where the tokens overlap (e.g. "beta"): Status is upstream-declared lifecycle, Stage is ID-derived. "none" is the zero value (absence is meaningful on this scalar field: the ID carries no stage marker); "other" is the RESERVED fail-safe for a future non-ID feeder (unused by the ID-detection path this epoch, raw value carried on ModelInfo.StageRaw). ID-detected tokens this epoch: preview/beta/latest/original; stable/alpha/experimental are enum members for parse completeness but are not ID-detected yet. Added in schema 0.4.0.

x-enum-descriptions.none: The ID carries no recognized stage marker (the zero value): a normal, generally-available release.
x-enum-descriptions.stable: An explicitly stable/GA release. Enum member for parse completeness; not ID-detected this epoch.
x-enum-descriptions.beta: A beta release (ID-detected, without stripping the token from the decomposition).
x-enum-descriptions.alpha: An early, unstable alpha release. Enum member for parse completeness; not ID-detected this epoch.
x-enum-descriptions.experimental: An experimental release. Enum member for parse completeness; neither it nor the "-exp" short form is ID-detected this epoch.
x-enum-descriptions.latest: A rolling "latest" alias (ID-detected). Names a moving target, not a fixed artifact property.
x-enum-descriptions.original: A rolling "original" alias (ID-detected). Names a moving target, not a fixed artifact property.
x-enum-descriptions.other: Reserved fail-safe bucket for a future non-ID stage feeder; unused by the ID path this epoch. Raw token carried on ModelInfo.StageRaw.

Region.title: Region
Region.description: Serving jurisdiction of a model instance: the AWS Bedrock cross-region inference-profile region encoded in a dotted "<region>.<vendor>." model-ID prefix. A per-instance attribute that never participates in entity identity. Serializes as a lowercase token via encoding.TextMarshaler. "unspecified" is the zero value (RegionNone — the ID carries no region prefix; rendered as a word, never blank, for external-reader clarity); "other" is the fail-safe bucket for a recognized-but-unmapped token (raw carried on RegionRaw). Member values follow ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 where applicable (us/au/jp; eu is the ISO exceptionally-reserved code); apac/global are provider-defined scopes outside ISO. au and jp are DISTINCT members (never folded into a single Asia-Pacific bucket) for data-protection-jurisdiction fidelity. Added in schema 0.5.0.

x-enum-descriptions.unspecified: The zero value (RegionNone): the model ID carries no Bedrock region prefix.
x-enum-descriptions.us: AWS "us" cross-region inference profile (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 US).
x-enum-descriptions.eu: AWS "eu" cross-region inference profile (ISO exceptionally-reserved EU).
x-enum-descriptions.apac: AWS "apac" cross-region scope (provider-defined, outside ISO). RESERVED: documented by Bedrock but zero attested instances today.
x-enum-descriptions.au: AWS "au" cross-region inference profile (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 AU, Australia — a distinct data-protection jurisdiction).
x-enum-descriptions.jp: AWS "jp" cross-region inference profile (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 JP, Japan — a distinct data-protection jurisdiction).
x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket for a recognized-but-unmapped region token; raw carried on RegionRaw.

NomenScheme.title: NomenScheme
NomenScheme.description: Classifies a Nomen by the KIND of naming it records — a provenance classifier, NOT a rendering codec (deliberately distinct from CanonicalScheme, which is a render codec). Serializes as a lowercase token via encoding.TextMarshaler. Element-enum convention: every nomen is minted with a known scheme, so "other" is the fail-safe bucket at the zero value. Added in schema 0.5.0.

x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket (the zero value) for an unclassifiable naming.
x-enum-descriptions.canonical: The entity key itself (the Preferred designation of an entity).
x-enum-descriptions.provider-id: A provider's verbatim model-ID spelling (an Admitted designation).
x-enum-descriptions.huggingface: A HuggingFace Hub org/repo naming (reserved; seeded via curated claims).
x-enum-descriptions.purl: A Package-URL naming (reserved for the external-identifier slice).
x-enum-descriptions.alias: A third-party-asserted alias, claim-attributed via SourceURL (an Admitted designation).

Nomen.title: Nomen
Nomen.description: One recorded NAMING of an entity: a value string classified by scheme, carrying its acceptability status, the entity it resolves to, and its provenance recorded as an Attestations evidence set (the Wikidata per-claim-reference model — each attestation independently carries its own claimant URL and ingest source). The prior scalar SourceURL/Source fields were removed in favor of Attestations; they are intentionally absent from this $def. An Entity HAS-MANY Nomina; the canonical key IS the entity's Preferred nomen. Added in schema 0.5.0.

Value.description: The naming string (a raw model ID, a canonical key, or an alias spelling).

Status.description: ISO-1087 acceptability rating. Canonical nomina are "preferred"; provider-ID and alias nomina are "admitted".

ResolvesTo.description: The entity this naming denotes. One spelling may resolve to several entities (homonymy).

Attestations.description: The evidence set for this naming (>=1): each element is one independent piece of evidence (the Wikidata per-claim-reference model). Two sources asserting the same name append two attestations rather than overwriting. Added in schema 0.6.0; optional (an empty/omitted set is a nomen with no recorded evidence yet).

LinkType.title: LinkType
LinkType.description: Classifies a model reference link (the type tag on a models.json links[] row, or the synthetic tag for a folded-in weights[] row), identified by its canonical lowercase wire name. Serializes as a string via encoding.TextMarshaler. "other" is the zero value and fail-safe bucket for an unrecognized tag (raw token carried on ModelLink.TypeRaw) — on an element type the upstream tag is always present, so a zero value can only mean unrecognized. Added in schema 0.3.0.

x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket (the zero value) for an unrecognized link type; raw token carried on ModelLink.TypeRaw.
x-enum-descriptions.model_card: A model card (e.g. on a model hub).
x-enum-descriptions.paper: A research paper or technical report.
x-enum-descriptions.weights: A downloadable-weights reference (a folded-in weights[] row).

ModelLink.title: ModelLink
ModelLink.description: One reference link for a model: a labeled URL with a classified type. Upstream weights[] rows fold in here with Type "weights".

Type.description: Classified link type. Serializes as a LinkType enum string.

TypeRaw.description: Verbatim upstream type token, populated only when Type is "other" (an unrecognized tag); empty otherwise.

BenchmarkResult.title: BenchmarkResult
BenchmarkResult.description: One benchmark claim as reported by the publishing organization. Fields are grouped along the assessment-provenance joints (criterion identity: Name/Version/Variant/Dataset; apparatus: Harness; assessment value: Metric/Score/ScoreRaw; claim attribution: SourceURL/Date) and are never concatenated. Scores are attributed claims by the publishing lab, not independent measurements.

Version.description: Benchmark version, when the source distinguishes one.

Variant.description: Benchmark variant / subtask, when the source distinguishes one.

Dataset.description: Evaluation dataset, when the source names one.

Harness.description: Evaluation harness / framework used, when the source names one.

Score.description: Numeric score, or 0 when the upstream score is non-numeric (see ScoreRaw).

ScoreRaw.description: Verbatim upstream score when it is non-numeric; empty when Score is numeric. Upstream reports a score as either a number or a string, so a string score is preserved here rather than dropping the row.

SourceURL.description: URL of the original claimant (the lab blog or model card). Named SourceURL, not Source, to avoid colliding with the DataSourceID-typed ingest-attestation fields: claim attribution and ingest attestation are different provenance levels.

Date.description: Claim date in YYYY-MM-DD format, when the source gives one.

ReasoningOption.title: ReasoningOption
ReasoningOption.description: One reasoning-control option a model exposes, as a discriminated union keyed by Kind. Only the payload fields relevant to Kind carry data: "effort" populates Values; "budget_tokens" populates MinTokens/MaxTokens; "toggle" carries neither.

Kind.description: Discriminates which payload fields are meaningful. Serializes as a ReasoningOptionKind enum string ("other"/"toggle"/"effort"/"budget_tokens").

KindRaw.description: Verbatim upstream kind token, populated only when Kind is "other" (an unrecognized tag); empty otherwise.

Values.description: Discrete choices for an "effort" option; null otherwise.

MinTokens.description: Lower budget bound for a "budget_tokens" option; 0 otherwise.

MaxTokens.description: Upper budget bound for a "budget_tokens" option; 0 otherwise.

ReasoningOptionKind.title: ReasoningOptionKind
ReasoningOptionKind.description: Discriminates the kind of a reasoning-control option, identified by its canonical lowercase wire name. Serializes as a string via encoding.TextMarshaler. "other" is the zero value and fail-safe bucket for an unrecognized tag (raw token carried on ReasoningOption.KindRaw). Added in schema 0.3.0.

x-enum-descriptions.other: Fail-safe bucket (the zero value) for an unrecognized reasoning-option kind; raw token carried on ReasoningOption.KindRaw.
x-enum-descriptions.effort: A discrete effort selector; the choices are on ReasoningOption.Values.
x-enum-descriptions.budget_tokens: A token-budget control; the bounds are on ReasoningOption.MinTokens/MaxTokens.

TierCost.title: TierCost
TierCost.description: One bundle of cost overrides; every axis is optional (a null pointer means not overridden). Mirrors the flat cost fields on ModelInfo and adds audio input/output rates. Serialized as an object when present (ModelInfo.CostContextOver200k) and flattened into CostTier when embedded.

CostInputPerMTok.description: Input cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostOutputPerMTok.description: Output cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostReasoningPerMTok.description: Reasoning cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostCacheReadPerMTok.description: Cache-read cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostCacheWritePerMTok.description: Cache-write cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostInputAudioPerMTok.description: Audio-input cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostOutputAudioPerMTok.description: Audio-output cost in USD per million tokens, or null when unset.

CostTier.title: CostTier
CostTier.description: A context-size-conditional price tier: the cost overrides apply once the request context reaches ContextSize tokens. Upstream, a tier's type is always "context", so only the token threshold is modeled (ContextSize); the embedded TierCost cost fields flatten to the tier level. Kept distinct from ModelInfo.CostContextOver200k (upstream's legacy fixed-threshold special case) for wire fidelity.

ContextSize.description: Token threshold at which this tier's overrides apply.

CostInputPerMTok.description: Input cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

CostOutputPerMTok.description: Output cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

CostReasoningPerMTok.description: Reasoning cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

CostCacheReadPerMTok.description: Cache-read cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

CostCacheWritePerMTok.description: Cache-write cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

CostInputAudioPerMTok.description: Audio-input cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

CostOutputAudioPerMTok.description: Audio-output cost in USD per million tokens at this tier, or null when unset.

EntityMetadata.title: EntityMetadata
EntityMetadata.description: Provider-agnostic model facts from the models.dev models.json side: description, license, reference links, and lab-reported benchmark claims, keyed by the stable MetadataID. Carries NO status property (status is an api.json / instance-level fact and lives on ModelInfo only).

Links.description: Reference links; upstream weights[] rows fold in with Type "weights". null when the source lists none.

Benchmarks.description: Lab-reported benchmark claims. null when the source lists none.

Source.description: Ingest attestation — the data source this metadata was read from (e.g. "models.dev"). Empty string (DataSourceNone) when unassigned.

LastSynced.description: RFC3339 timestamp; empty on baked rows until a sync occurs.
